releases.name: Devil & Angel Sky Battle
releases.summary: High above the stars, an angel and a devil circle a gleaming board and fight the oldest argument there is — with clouds.Take turns flying around the board's edge, pick a row or a column, and hurl your cloud in from either end. Your cloud lands on the first square and everything in its path slides along one place. Run out of room and the cloud at the far end is shoved clean off the edge, where it bursts in a shower of light.Make a full line of your own clouds — across, down or corner to corner — and you win.The catch is that nothing ever stays where you put it. Every throw your opponent makes can push your careful row apart, or nudge one of your own clouds into a line you never planned. A board that looks lost can turn in a single shove. There are no safe squares, only the ones your rival hasn't reached yet.Two house rules keep the fight moving: nobody may play the same throw three times running, and nobody may answer a throw by shoving the same line straight back. No stalemates, no endless tug of war — just position, pressure and the nerve to commit.Play your waySet the board up how you like it before each match:- Grid size — 3×3 for a quick knife fight, 4×4 and 5×5 for real strategy, or 6×6 for a long war of attrition- Board starting fill — begin on an empty board at 0%, or dive straight into the chaos at 30%, 60% or 90% full- Pick your side — take the angel's white clouds or the devil's thunderheads; your opponent takes the other- Who plays — each side can be a player or the console, so play head to head, take on the machine, or sit back and watch two AIs fight it out- Four levels of opponentBeginner, Rookie, Experienced and Expert. Even the gentlest opponent thinks several moves ahead and sets traps of its own — the harder levels simply stop making mistakes. The Expert sees six moves deep and does not forgive a loose cloud.Features- One or two players, side by side on the same console- Four board sizes and four starting fills — sixteen ways to set up a match- Four difficulty levels with a genuinely thinking opponent- Diagonals count, on every board size- Your record against the console is kept for each board size- Instant rematches — win, watch the board clear, and go again

releases.name: Fitness Club Simulator 2027
releases.summary:
Build, manage, expand, and take your gym to the top.

Turn a small gym into the next fitness sensation and build a business that makes an impact across the city. Start with a simple space, make smart investments, and transform your first location into a thriving destination where people come to train, improve, and reach their goals. Every decision shapes your success as you turn ambition into a growing fitness empire.

Explore the city, discover new opportunities, and open additional gyms in different locations. Design each space your way, upgrade your facilities, manage your staff, and create a recognizable brand that keeps attracting new clients. Balance your finances, reputation, and daily operations as your business grows from a modest gym into a name the entire city knows.

Key Features:
• Build Your Fitness Empire: Start with one gym and expand your business across the city.
• Design Unique Gyms: Customize layouts, equipment, atmosphere, and the overall look of every location.
• Upgrade and Expand: Invest in better equipment, new facilities, and additional areas to unlock new possibilities.
• Manage Your Business: Hire staff, control expenses, and make strategic decisions to keep your gyms running efficiently.
• Create Your Brand: Develop a distinctive fitness identity and build a reputation that attracts more clients.

releases.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
releases.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

releases.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
releases.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

releases.name: Seahorse Soap Patrol
releases.summary:
A squad of seahorses must send polluters packing!

When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse
Soap Patrol to clean things up! Float through different underwater biomes,
blowing sud bubbles at naughty nautiluses, smelly sharks, and more! Pick
up the trash and make the ocean a fresh, clean home for all to enjoy.

releases.name: Vixen 357
releases.summary:
This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units. Year of 2396.

The high-mobility armored trooper "Vector," secretly developed to replace the former main weapon, "SERD."

One day, a mysterious unit attacked the base of Slash Unit, who had been training to become the pilots of Vectors. But who are they…?

Now, the battle begins again, with the secrets lie hidden!

This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.

16 different levels of pure tactical strategy.

Features:

• Strategic Freedom: Assign any VECTOR to any character.

• Permadeath: Mistakes are permanent. Command wisely.

• Narrative Decisions: Trust no one. Learn the truth through survival.

* Gallery: view images from the original game’s illustrations, posters, box design, etc.

* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up

* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)

* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point

* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)

releases.name: Omni Growth
releases.summary: The last hope of your species. Consume your prey, evolve, and turn an abandoned galactic ship into your personal hunting grounds as you become a deadly predator.

releases.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
releases.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

releases.name: Cozy Packing
releases.summary:
Pack your bags and grab your furry companions for a cozy trip!

From folding clothes into a suitcase to setting up a campsite, arranging a bakery display, building a cheese board, slicing a pizza, matching tulip colors, or piecing together a stained glass window, every scene turns everyday travel tasks into a soothing puzzle. Relax, take your time, and enjoy the little details of life on the road with the ones you love.

Key Features:
- A variety of cozy packing and sorting puzzles, from suitcases to bakery boxes and beyond
- Follow a couple and their pets through charming travel-themed scenes
- Hand-painted, warm and pastel art style
- Relaxing, no-pressure gameplay perfect for unwinding

releases.name: Calcium Chaos
releases.summary:
Combine unconventional items into weapons to save the world!

Skeletons are invading, and your only defense is a toaster and a chicken! Embark on a whimsical adventure through a land plagued by pesky skeletons! Uncover weird and wacky weapon synergies to fight back against the bony baddies. Along the way, you'll gather a rag-tag group of heroes who will aid you on your mission- will you have the guts to stop the necromancer's plans and save the world?

Discover an arsenal of ONE MILLION different weapon combinations, from explosive toast to homing robot chickens, and customize your loadout to suit your playstyle as you wreak havoc on your enemies.

Recruit up to four friends to join your quest to defeat the necromancer, or measure yourself by playing alone.

Transform your train into a formidable base of operations for the friends you meet along the way, buy upgrades, decorate your train, and prepare your next mission!

Dive into procedurally generated levels filled with challenges! Test your skills and adaptability as you strive to overcome the ever-growing threats that await you.

releases.name: Megalopolis SOS
releases.summary:
City Defense Shooter: Protect the World from the UFO Invasion! Defend our cities from the alien swarm.

Retro Arcade Action: Defend the World!
Originally released in 1983, this classic shooter puts you in command of global defense. Maneuver your turret left and right, launching bullets and floating mines to intercept relentless UFO attacks.

Clear each stage by destroying a set number of enemies. But beware—the mission ends if you lose all your lives or if every city under your protection is leveled.

Six iconic cities stand between you and the invaders: NYC, LON, TKY, MOW, PEK, and PAR. Be careful—dodging a bullet might mean letting a city take the hit instead. The secret to victory? Stay on the offensive! To minimize damage and save the world, you must take the fight to them.

releases.name: Slot & Learn Easy English Words
releases.summary:
Just starting to learn English?

This easygoing learning game helps beginners practice familiar English words in a fun, game-like way.

Look at each question and discover how to say everyday things and commonly used words in English.

Playing is simple!
• Read the question carefully
• Think of the right English word
• Choose an answer and take on the question

Start with basic vocabulary instead of difficult material. It’s a friendly first step for anyone who wants to begin learning English.

Ever seen a word and thought, “I know that—but how do you say it in English?” Check words one at a time and get comfortable with English while you play.

Easy to pick up in short sessions, it’s great for a little daily practice, as well as previewing and reviewing English vocabulary.

Recommended for people who want to:
• Start learning English
• Build a foundation with basic words
• Find a game that’s an easy introduction to English study
• Practice English in a relaxed, game-like way

releases.name: Bottle Logic Puzzle
releases.summary:
Pour, sort, and solve in Bottle Logic Puzzle!

Dive into a colorful and relaxing puzzle game where every move counts! Sort colorful liquids between bottles until each bottle contains just one color. Plan your moves carefully, think ahead, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving each puzzle.
With charming hand-drawn backgrounds, vibrant colors, and increasingly challenging levels, Bottle Logic Puzzle offers a delightful way to unwind while putting your logical thinking to the test.
Game Features:
- Colorful liquid-sorting puzzles that are easy to learn but challenging to master.
- Increasingly challenging levels that test your logic and planning skills.
- Beautiful hand-drawn backgrounds and charming visual themes.
- Simple, intuitive controls for a smooth puzzle-solving experience.
- Helpful hints when you need a little guidance.
- Relaxing gameplay with no rush — solve puzzles at your own pace.
Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to enjoy a longer puzzle session, Bottle Logic Puzzle is a colorful little challenge for your brain!

releases.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
releases.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

releases.name: Korean Rail Celesti Express KTX Seoul-Busan
Do Not Feed the Monkeys 2099
releases.summary: Spy on strangers through security cameras, invade their privacy and discover their secrets in this digital voyeur simulator. Welcome to the future of The Primate Observation Club. Even in 2099 the rule about messing with your unlucky subjects still remains in this sequel: DO NOT feed the monkeys!

releases.name: X-Force Genesis 2
releases.summary: X-Force Genesis 2The chaos is back in space!Get ready for a frantic and challenging shmup experience inspired by the classic space shooters of the 80s and 90s.Pilot your ship through 12 intense stages, face waves of enemies, dodge hundreds of projectiles, and take on gigantic bosses in explosive battles.Every second will test your reflexes, strategy, and skills. Dodge, attack, upgrade your ship, and survive the chaos!FRANTIC ACTIONFace dozens of enemies simultaneously as a relentless storm of projectiles fills the screen.Keep moving, find gaps between the attacks, and survive increasingly difficult attack patterns.CHOOSE YOUR SHIPChoose from different ships, each with unique characteristics and attributes.Find the ship that best matches your playstyle and take advantage of its strengths to overcome the challenges of each stage.BOSS BATTLESGigantic enemies await at the end of the stages.Face enormous bosses, learn their attack patterns, dodge their projectiles, and find the perfect moment to strike.The farther you go, the more dangerous the challenges become.UPGRADE YOUR SHIPStrengthen your ship throughout your journey and prepare to face increasingly powerful enemies.Use upgrades and Power-ups to increase your firepower and turn your ship into a true destruction machine.FEATURES* 12 stages packed with action and challenges.* Various enemies with different attack patterns.* Hundreds of projectiles on screen at the same time.* Gigantic and challenging bosses.* Different ships to choose from.* Upgrades to increase your ship's power.* Power-ups to turn the tide in critical moments.* Comets and other hazards to avoid throughout the stages.* An experience inspired by classic shmups from the 80s and 90s.* An intense action campaign that puts your reflexes to the test.Prepare your ship. Face the chaos. Survive the battle.X-Force Genesis 2 is waiting for you.
